objective: Stop presenting the event replay ratio as task progress. The bar names what it counts, exposes numerator and denominator, and no longer implies a completion claim.
decision_supported: Is visible/total events a measure of task progress? No: it is replay position, and a run can sit at 90% with nothing succeeded.
acceptance: The bar is labelled as event replay position, not task progress.
The numerator and denominator are both rendered.
Task completion is never derived from the ratio.
stop_conditions: The change would need an event schema change.
risks_and_fallbacks: Renaming the field could break a consumer; the read model is derived client-side and no test referenced the old name.
Fallback: keep progress as a deprecated alias.
